steps.what: water, to over 10 % milk by volume
steps.note: Above 30 % milk, harmless mould grew on the upper leaves.

steps.name: spray the leaves
steps.note: Twice a week from the first signs of mildew at 10 % or more, or once a week at 20-50 %.

links.name: Vegalab: Milk spray, what doesn't work

sources.text: The dilution and spraying of the 1999 Brazilian greenhouse tests on zucchini, as summarised there; fresh cow's milk was used, not skimmed, and the page gives no mixing or spray volumes.
